email.subject: Quick fix for Mane Street Group's site
email.body:
Hi Dev,

I checked Mane Street Group Hair Studio's website. Two things are likely costing you bookings: there's no click-to-call link, so anyone searching on their phone has to manually dial or retype your number, and there are no customer reviews shown, which makes new visitors less likely to trust and book. Your hours aren't listed either, so people can't tell if you're open right now.

I fix these kinds of issues for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what's hurting conversions, no obligation.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
